title: An optimized protocol for coupling oxygen consumption rates with β-oxidation in isolated mitochondria from mouse soleus
protocol: Sacrifice mice in a CO2 chamber.
Extract soleus muscles from mice hindlimbs using pre-cooled and sterilized surgical material inside a laminar flow cabinet.
Fix the mouse leg in a flexed position to the dissecting table and cover it with cold 1× PBS solution.
Remove hair, skin, and surrounding fascia carefully.
Cut the Achilles tendon precisely.
Separate the soleus muscle from the hindlimb and clean it thoroughly to remove any leftover fascia.
Transfer the extracted soleus muscle immediately to cold PBS.
Wash soleus in cold PBS 1× in a pre-cooled 50 mL glass beaker.
Mince muscles in four volumes of buffer A until pieces are homogeneous with the help of pre-cooled surgical scissors.
Incubate sample on ice for 5-10 minutes after adding Nagarse or other smooth proteases.
Transfer homogenized suspension immediately to pre-cooled centrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge the homogenized suspension for 10 min at 700 g at 4°C.
Discard pellet containing nucleus and intact cells.
Repeat homogenization and centrifugation steps once.
Centrifuge supernatant for 10 min at 10,000 g at 4°C.
Eliminate supernatant.
Suspend mitochondria enriched pellet in 100 μL of buffer B.
Measure mitochondria protein by Bradford method in a spectrophotometer.
Add 500 μL of respiration buffer to the electrode working chamber.
Close the chamber.
Inject 30–100 μg of mitochondrial protein into the chamber.
Start recording the trace by clicking GO.
At 30 seconds, inject 5 μL from a 50 mM malate stock and 5 μL from a 5 mM palmitoyl-carnitine stock.
Label the injection.
Inject 10 μL from a 500 mM glutamate/malate stock.
Label the injection.
Inject 10 μL from a 500 mM succinate stock.
Label the injection.
Add 1 μM rotenone before substrate injection to avoid retrograde electron transfer.
Inject 250 μM ADP at 2 minutes and 30 seconds after the start of measurement.
At 4 minutes and 30 seconds, inject 1 mM ADP.
At 5 minutes and 30 seconds, inject 5 μM oligomycin.
At 6 minutes and 30 seconds, inject 5 μM FCCP.
At 7 minutes and 30 seconds, inject 1 μM antimycin A.
Stop measurement at 8 minutes and 30 seconds by clicking the STOP button.
Save the trace by clicking file and selecting save as.
Clean Hamilton syringe twice with EtOH and H2O after each injection.
